content: Inorganic Compounds by Element This document provides a detailed list of common inorganic and organometallic compounds for each chemical element. The compounds are organized alphabetically by the name of the element, rather than by their chemical symbols. Each compound listed may be significant enough to warrant its own dedicated page. If any compounds are missing or newly discovered, they should be added to this list.
